White background remover

White backgrounds are the easiest to remove because they are so uniform. BG Studio finds the white (or off-white) area that touches the edges of your picture and turns it transparent, while leaving the rest of the image untouched.

How to remove a white background

  1. Add your image by dropping, pasting or browsing.
  2. Click Pick color and tap the white area, or just press Auto-detect.
  3. Tune Tolerance: higher removes off-white and light grey shadows, lower keeps them.
  4. Download as PNG or WebP to keep the transparency.

Tips for white backgrounds

  • Photos taken on white paper often have grey shading. Raise Tolerance to about 30–45 to clear it.
  • If white parts of your subject (teeth, eyes, text) start disappearing, keep “Only remove areas connected to the image edges” on.
  • To do the opposite and fill transparent areas with white, set Transparent areas to “Fill with color”.

Frequently asked questions

Will it remove the white inside my subject too?

Not by default. With the edge option on, only white that is connected to the image borders is removed, so white inside the subject stays.

What tolerance should I use?

Start at 22. Raise it for shadows and off-white backgrounds, and lower it when the subject itself is very light.

Can I remove other colors, like green or blue?

Yes. Click Pick color and tap any solid background color.

Is my image uploaded?

No. Everything runs in your browser, so your picture never leaves your device.
